dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: CRS-34 Dragon Targets May 12 ISS Cargo Launch; IFT-12 Still Late-May After OLP-2 Repair — 56 Launches, 609 Landings; IPO S-1 ~10 Days Out
heroSubtitle: 8,768 days of SpaceX milestones — CRS-34 Cargo Dragon set for May 12 (7:16 p.m. EDT, SLC-40), delivering ~6,500 lbs of science experiments and crew supplies to ISS (SpaceX's 57th orbital mission of 2026 if nominal). IFT-12 (Booster 19 / Ship 39 / Block 3 V3, 100t+ LEO) targets late May (est. May 27–31) as OLP-2 water deluge repair continues; stack unaffected. Public IPO S-1 expected May 18–22; management roadshow June 8; Nasdaq debut June 18–30 at $1.75T valuation ($75B raise). Bank of America (May 6, CNBC) warned simultaneous SpaceX + Anthropic mega-IPOs could mark a bull market inflection point.
